native_evidence.scope: One exploratory native DINO CEM paired root, with the fixed execution-equivalent canonical rewrite applied only to copied forecast requests. This is not Goal-Swap or the earlier fixed +2 operation.
native_evidence.established: The controlled representation intervention changed native planning and reduced cumulative real dense return on this paired root.
native_evidence.mixed_metrics: Canonical first reached success earlier, spent more controls in success, and ended closer to the goal with a higher terminal reward. Both final success flags were false. The dense-return reduction is not a demonstrated loss of goal attainment or a uniform deterioration across utility measures.
not_established: Population attack success rate or statistical significance
Native CEM candidate-ranking mediation of the dense-return difference
A new universal world-model security mechanism
native_evidence.post_diagnostic_synthesis: The return loss coexists with lower average paired observed-prefix feature error within both origin panels, earlier first success, more successful controls, and a better endpoint. This is not proof of prediction damage or lost task success. Conventional input binding restores the Clean same-root return and saved trace.

prior_true_future_control.scope: Earlier frozen five-candidate, 30-control open-loop bank; not the later native CEM trajectories.
prior_true_future_control.finding: The unchanged native objective applied to actual future feature encodings selects candidate 1, the same low-real-utility candidate as canonicalization, while original forecasts select candidate 2.
prior_true_future_control.interpretation: Objective/reward mismatch limits exclusive attribution to newly worsened predictions. It does not erase the incremental representation-to-selection utility effect, rule out coexistence with forecast-mediated harm, or impose oracle-optimal scoring as a prerequisite for research.

primary_literature.title: Clipped Action Policy Gradient
primary_literature.verified_scope: Section 3, equations 4-6, and section 3.4; transition/reward invariance under action clipping and the exception for raw-action-dependent rewards.
primary_literature.claim_supported: Execution equivalence under a clipping actuator contract is established prior work.
primary_literature.claim_not_supported: This paper alone does not establish or exhaust security implications of a constrained forecast-request writer, or universal observational conditional invariance under partial observability.

primary_literature.title: World Models / Recurrent World Models Facilitate Policy Evolution
primary_literature.verified_scope: Author page, Cheating the World Model section.
primary_literature.claim_supported: A controller exploiting imperfections of a learned model and failing in the real environment is established prior work.
primary_literature.claim_not_supported: The example does not by itself cover an external writer restricted to execution-equivalent request representations.

primary_literature.title: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
primary_literature.verified_scope: Official NeurIPS 2020 abstract: equivalence with respect to policy/function classes via Bellman updates and model usefulness for value-based planning.
primary_literature.claim_supported: Planning usefulness and complete predictive fidelity are distinct properties; lower generic feature error alone is insufficient evidence of improved decision utility.
primary_literature.claim_not_supported: The abstract is not a direct causal explanation or theorem about this DINO latent-distance objective.

sole_interface_boundary_gap.question: What concrete component and source-to-sink interface permits a lower-trust writer to change forecast action representation while withholding authority over the protected executed action, task goal, and planner scoring rule?
sole_interface_boundary_gap.current_evidence: The experiment implements a researcher-defined constrained writer. No native external lower-trust writer path has been demonstrated in the reviewed records.
sole_interface_boundary_gap.validity_without_deployment: A researcher-defined threat model is valid for bounded controlled experiments without proof of a deployed writer. Missing native external reachability does not erase the causal findings and is not grounds to block all further research.
sole_interface_boundary_gap.claim_boundary: Missing native interface evidence limits claims of a native vulnerability, realistic external exploitability, or deployment exposure. If the boundary exists only in a newly composed system, identify that system explicitly instead of presenting the added hook as an existing native interface.
sole_interface_boundary_gap.minimal_resolution: Document one actual component authority contract and its call path, or explicitly retain the researcher-defined/new-composition scope. No seed or attack expansion is proposed by this review.

cpu_forecast_analysis.failure: The first endpoint visual encoder failed elementwise allclose(atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-4), despite passing the separate aggregate maximum and RMS thresholds.
cpu_forecast_analysis.scope: No paired native prediction-error direction was measured. Preserve this failed protocol without tolerance relaxation, retry, or silent fallback.

separate_same_gpu_diagnostic.methodological_assessment: The separately registered same-GPU diagnostic preserved the numeric limits and complete fixed panel, passed all own-condition calibration gates, and measured symmetric within-query representation effects without rerunning environments or planners. The CPU protocol remains invalid and unchanged.
separate_same_gpu_diagnostic.limit: Lower average observed-prefix feature error has mixed per-endpoint and per-query signs. These final-mean results do not establish CEM candidate-ranking mediation, full-horizon objective error, or lost task success.

recovery.interpretation: Conventional trusted-current-candidate binding restores the same-root Clean behavior and cumulative return. It is causal restoration under the stipulated boundary, not a novel defense, independent-root generalization, or proof of forecast accuracy improvement.

pending_diagnostics.section_status: Updated after both formerly pending experiments completed; original CPU invalid record retained.

decision.bounded_empirical_claim: Go: preserve the controlled native representation effect, real dense-return loss, and exact same-root restoration. Report lower average paired prefix feature error and improved success-related metrics alongside the loss, with heterogeneous local error signs and prior proxy-mismatch evidence.
decision.broad_security_claim_or_expansion_on_pre: No-Go: present evidence does not establish a novel general security mechanism, native external exploitability, or independent generalization.
decision.continued_research: The completed recovery and calibrated same-GPU diagnostic answer their narrow questions. They neither erase the causal outcome nor establish prediction-damage mediation, native external exploitability, or novelty. Missing native deployment evidence does not prohibit bounded researcher-defined threat models or all further research.
decision.novelty: Unproved; no numeric novelty score. The reviewed literature covers individual ingredients but is not an exhaustive proof that every constrained-writer formulation has already been studied.
